info.title: SX Bet API
info.description:
REST API for the SX Bet decentralized sports betting exchange. Retrieve sports data, markets, and orderbook information. Post, cancel, and fill orders with signed payloads.

Base URLs:
- **Mainnet**: `https://api.sx.bet`
- **Testnet**: `https://api.toronto.sx.bet`

tags.name: Sports Data
tags.description: Sports, leagues, teams, fixtures, and live scores

tags.name: Markets
tags.description: Active, specific, and popular betting markets

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Orderbook queries, posting, cancelling, and filling orders

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Legacy header, distinct from `x-sx-api-key` — see [API keys](/api-reference/api-key). Declared only on `POST /heartbeat`; see [Heartbeat](/developers/heartbeat) for what that route does and doesn't do.

SxApiKey.name: x-sx-api-key
SxApiKey.description: API key, sent as the `x-sx-api-key` header.

sportId.description: The ID of the sport this league corresponds to

active.description: Whether or not the league is active on SX.bet currently

sport.description: The sport this team belongs to

active.description: Whether this sport is currently active on SX.bet

participantOneName.description: The first participant in the fixture. Present if it's a two-participant event.

participantTwoName.description: The second participant in the fixture. Present if it's a two-participant event.

participants.description: All the participants in the fixture. Present if it's an n-participant event.

startDate.description: The start date of the event in UTC time

status.description: The status of the fixture. See the [status table](/api-reference/get-fixture-status) for more details.

leagueId.description: The ID of the league this fixture belongs to

leagueLabel.description: The name of the league this fixture belongs to

sportId.description: The ID of the sport this fixture belongs to

leagueId.description: The league ID for this match

periodTime.description: The time in the period. If it's `"-1"`, it is not available or the game is finished

teamOneScore.description: The score of team one in this period

teamTwoScore.description: The score of team two in this period

periods.description: All of the periods in the match

sportId.description: The ID of the sport for this match

teamOneScore.description: The current score for team one

teamTwoScore.description: The current score for team two

sportXeventId.description: The event ID for this match

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was last updated

status.description: `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE`

marketHash.description: The unique identifier for the market

teamOneName.description: The name of the first team/player participating

teamTwoName.description: The name of the second team/player participating

gameTime.description: Scheduled start of the game, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds

line.description: The line of the market. Only applicable to markets with a line

sportXeventId.description: The unique event ID for this market

liveEnabled.description: Whether or not this match is available for live betting

sportLabel.description: The name of the sport for this market

sportId.description: The ID of the sport for this market

leagueId.description: The league ID for this market

leagueLabel.description: The name of the league for this market

mainLine.description: If this market is currently the main line or not. If the market is not a market with multiple lines, this field will not be present

isQuarterLineMarket.description: `true` if this market is a quarter-line market (Asian handicap or totals in .25 increments). See the [quarter lines changelog entry](/changelog#quarter-lines-gradual-rollout) for details.

group1.description: Indicator to the client of how to display this market

chainVersion.description: The chain version this market is deployed on

participantOneId.description: The team ID of participant one

participantTwoId.description: The team ID of participant two

legs.description: If this is a Parlay Market, this field will contain an array of the underlying Legs as a Market object

group2.description: Secondary display grouping indicator for the market

marketMeta.description: Extra metadata for the market overall

reportedDate.description: UNIX timestamp of when the market was reported/settled

outcome.description: The reported outcome once settled: `0` for void, `1` or `2` for each side.

MetadataObv3.description: Runtime configuration for the exchange. Read every value at runtime — do not copy the examples. Only `domain.name` and `domain.version` are fixed; `chainId`, `domain.verifyingContract`, `activeAsset`, `transferToProxyExecutorAddress`, `bettingDelay`, and the order-size minimum are per-environment.

chainId.description: Chain id, used as the EIP-712 domain `chainId`. Differs per environment — see [Environments](/developers/environments).

domain.description: Complete EIP-712 domain. Pass this object straight to `signTypedData`. `name` and `version` are fixed; `chainId` and `verifyingContract` are per-environment.

version.description: EIP-712 domain version. The string "1", not "1.0".

chainId.description: EIP-712 domain chain id. Same value as the top-level `chainId`.

verifyingContract.description: EIP-712 verifying contract — the Escrow proxy. Same value as `activeAsset.escrowAddress`.

activeAsset.description: The single active (baseToken, escrowAddress) pair for this environment

baseToken.description: ERC-20 address of the settlement token. Pass this as `baseToken` when creating orders.

decimals.description: Token decimals — 6 for USDC. Every amount in the API is in base units.

transferToProxyExecutorAddress.description: Spender required on EIP-2612 permits when transferring tokens to a proxy via `POST /user/transfer-to-proxy`. A mismatch returns `ERC20_PERMIT_BAD_SPENDER`.

oddsLadderStepSize.description: Odds must be a multiple of this x 1e15. 125 means 0.125%.

orderSizeMinimum.description: Minimum order size in whole tokens.

orderSizeMinimumBaseUnits.description: The same minimum in base units. Compare `totalBetSize` against this one, not against `orderSizeMinimum`.

minRestingOrderSize.description: Minimum resting remainder in whole tokens. A partial fill that leaves less than this amount closes the order as filled (`inactiveReason` `FILLED`). Not the same as `orderSizeMinimum`.

minRestingOrderSizeBaseUnits.description: The same minimum resting remainder in base units. A partial fill that leaves less than this amount is discarded and the order closes as filled (`inactiveReason` `FILLED`). Not the same as `orderSizeMinimumBaseUnits`.

maxCancelOrders.description: Maximum order ids in one cancel request.

limits.description: Batch and size limits for this environment.

bettingDelay.description: Per-order delay in milliseconds before an order that takes resting liquidity becomes eligible to match. An order that only adds liquidity is unaffected and rests immediately. Live resolution: `leagueIdToMs[leagueId]`, then `sportIdToMs[sportId]`, then `liveMsDefault`. Pregame uses `pregameMsDefault` only. See [Betting delays](/developers/betting-delays).

liveMsDefault.description: Live-market delay in milliseconds when no league or sport override applies.

pregameMsDefault.description: Pregame delay in milliseconds. No league or sport override.

sportIdToMs.description: Per-sport live delay overrides in milliseconds. A matching league override wins.

leagueIdToMs.description: Per-league live delay overrides in milliseconds. Wins over the sport override and `liveMsDefault`.

CreateOrderItem.description: One signed order. Note there is no `useProxy` field — trading is proxy-only.

marketHash.description: The market you wish to place this order under

maker.description: Your user address. Must match the account that signs the order. This is NOT your proxy wallet address.

percentageOdds.description: Implied probability you are paying (maker's frame).

salt.description: Random 32-byte hex string to differentiate between orders with otherwise identical parameters

expiry.description: A unix epoch timestamp in **seconds** — not milliseconds, and an integer unlike the amount fields. Must be in the future — `0` is **not** accepted, and neither is any past timestamp (`expiry must be a unix-seconds timestamp in the future`). A value that falls inside the market's betting delay plus two seconds is rejected (`Order expiry is too close to the betting delay window`). Resolve the delay from `bettingDelay` on [`GET /metadata/obv3`](/api-reference/get-metadata-obv3).

isMakerBettingOutcomeOne.description: The outcome you want to bet. `true` selects outcome one; `false` selects outcome two.

timeInForce.description: Exactly one of `GTC`, `IOC`, `FOK` — case-sensitive, with no default. See [Time in force](/developers/time-in-force) for what each does and when to use it.

orderSignature.description: EIP-712 signature over the 8-field `Order` type, packed v-r-s (65 bytes). See [EIP-712 order signing](/api-reference/eip712-order-signing).

clientOrderId.description: Optional. Max 64 chars, `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` — a braced UUID is rejected. Must be unique per address: one collision fails the whole batch, not just that order. See [Client order id](/developers/client-order-id).

externalUserId.description: Optional partner tag. Max 255 chars. Attribution-only — echoed on privileged order/fill/trade reads and account channels. See [External user id](/developers/external-user-id).

useBetCredits.description: Fund from bet credits. IOC/FOK only. Still requires a deployed proxy.

postOnly.description: Optional. Add liquidity only. `GTC` only. An order that would cross on arrival is cancelled with `POST_ONLY_WOULD_CROSS` instead of taking. See [Time in force](/developers/time-in-force#post-only).

CreateOrderResult.description: One per-order result from `POST /orders-v3`. The response `data.orders` array contains one of these per submitted order, in the same order you sent them.

orderId.description: The order id — the EIP-712 digest of the signed `Order` struct.

status.description: `SUBMITTED` = submitted to the matching engine; `FAILED` = rejected before submitting. See [Posting orders](/developers/posting-orders).

commandId.description: Server-assigned id for this order's submission command. Correlate it with your own records; always present, including on `FAILED`.

clientOrderId.description: Your own tag, echoed back when you set one; omitted otherwise.

externalUserId.description: Optional partner tag, echoed back when you set one; omitted otherwise.

outcome.description: Present only when `waitForOutcome` was requested and the order was accepted (`SUBMITTED`). Absent on `FAILED` results.

CreateOrderOutcome.description: Terminal matching outcome for one order. Present only on `POST /orders-v3` results when `waitForOutcome` was requested and the order was accepted (`SUBMITTED`).

state.description: RESTED = rested with no fill; FULLY_FILLED = fully matched on entry; PARTIAL_FILL_DONE = partially filled, remainder discarded (IOC/dust); PARTIAL_FILL_RESTED = partially filled, remainder rested; CANCELLED = cancelled without resting (see `cancelReason`); TIMEOUT = no outcome before the wait deadline.

remainingAmount.description: Amount left unfilled after a settled outcome. Omitted on `TIMEOUT` because the order is still in flight.

fillAmount.description: Amount this order executed, in base units. Absent when the order never matched. See [unit conversions](/developers/unit-conversions).

blendedOdds.description: Effective blended execution odds across this order's matches, in the taker frame at 1e20 scale (divide by 10^20 for implied probability). Absent when the order never matched. See [unit conversions](/developers/unit-conversions).

matchIds.description: Match ids produced by this order. Absent when it never matched.

tradeId.description: Trade id grouping this order's fills. Absent when it never matched.

cancelReason.description: Why the order was cancelled. Present only when `state` is `CANCELLED`. These are the only values. Not the same set as [`inactiveReason`](/developers/order-lifecycle).

OrderV3.description: An order as read back. `timeInForce` is write-only and is NOT present here, and there is no `maker` or `baseToken` field.

id.description: The signed order ID, lowercase — the same key `POST /orders-v3` returned. See [Posting orders](/developers/posting-orders) for computing it locally before you submit.

marketHash.description: The market the order is on.

userAddress.description: Your user address — the address that signed.

wallet.description: Your proxy wallet — where the funds come from.

isBettingOutcomeOne.description: Which outcome the order backs. You submit this field as `isMakerBettingOutcomeOne` and read it back as `isBettingOutcomeOne`.

remainingSize.description: The unfilled portion of the original order size. The filled amount is `totalBetSize - remainingSize`. Use the `status` field to determine whether the remaining amount is still active.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 string — note you **send** `expiry` to `POST /orders-v3` as a unix epoch timestamp in seconds and read it back here as ISO 8601. Every order carries a real expiry; `null` appears only on legacy orders created before `expiry` became mandatory.

status.description: `PENDING`, `ACTIVE`, or `INACTIVE`. See [Order lifecycle](/developers/order-lifecycle).

inactiveReason.description: Why the order stopped resting. Set when `status` is `INACTIVE`, otherwise null.

eventId.description: Prefixed form, e.g. "L12003787" — the value to pass back as the `eventId` filter.

clientOrderId.description: What you sent on `POST /orders-v3`, present only when set.

externalUserId.description: Optional partner tag from `POST /orders-v3`, present only when set.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601. When the order was submitted — at `POST` time, before the order rested.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601. Last change; bumped by a fill or a status change.

OrderbookVersion.description: Book version — a single string that increases as the book changes. Apply an update only when it is strictly greater than the version you hold; compare as a string. All zeros means no snapshot row exists yet. See [Book versioning](/developers/book-versioning) for the per-market scope and the sparse spacing.

size.description: Aggregated MAKER stake at this level.

OrderbookSnapshot.description: The book has the same flat shape here as on the realtime orderbook channel: level arrays sit directly beside `marketHash` and `version`. Levels are aggregated across every order resting at the same price -- order count and per-order size are not recoverable, and only unfilled, non-expired size counts. See [The order book](/developers/order-book) for sort order and the empty-book case.

marketHash.description: Echoed back verbatim from the request.

outcomeOne.description: Price levels for outcome one, sorted descending by maker odds so index 0 is the best available price. `[]` when nothing rests there.

outcomeTwo.description: Price levels for outcome two, sorted descending by maker odds so index 0 is the best available price. `[]` when nothing rests there.

version.description: Book version. Apply an update only when it is strictly greater than the version you hold.

marketHash.description: The resulting market for the given best odds query

outcomeOne.description: Best level on outcome one, or `null` when that side has no resting orders.

outcomeTwo.description: Best level on outcome two, or `null` when that side has no resting orders.

outcome.description: 0 = void (or a corrupt row — there is no enum guarding this), 1 = outcome one, 2 = outcome two.

settleReturnAmount.description: Paid out at settlement, as a base-unit decimal string (USDC has 6 decimals).

settleFeeAmount.description: Fee taken at settlement, in base units. Always a string at bet grain; the same field on a fill may be null.

settleCeRefundAmount.description: Capital-efficiency refund snapshotted at settlement, in base units.

TradeV3.description: Bet grain: one row per bet. Carries `isParlay` but no quarter-line flag, so `/trades-v3` alone cannot distinguish a quarter-line bet from a single — drill into `/fills-v3`.

tradeId.description: Identifies the bet. Filter `GET /fills-v3` by this value.

userAddress.description: Your user address — the proxy owner.

wallet.description: The proxy wallet the funds moved from. A different address from `userAddress`.

marketHash.description: The market hash for this trade. For a quarter-line bet, this is the parent hash — leg hashes are on the fills. See [Quarter-line markets](/developers/quarter-line-markets) for how the parent and leg hashes relate.

isMaker.description: Which side of the book you were on. `true` when you were the maker — your order rested and was filled; `false` when you were the taker.

isParlay.description: True when `marketHash` is a parlay parent.

totalStake.description: What you risked, in base units.

totalReturn.description: Gross return if this bet wins, in base units, stake included. Profit is `totalReturn - totalStake`.

netTotalReturn.description: `totalReturn` less the settlement payout fee, projected from your per-wallet rate.

weightedAverageOdds.description: Implied odds. Stake-weighted mean of the fill odds.

ceRefundAmount.description: In base units. On a parlay row (`isParlay: true`), this is an early stake refund rather than a capital-efficiency refund — see [Your bets](/developers/which-grain#bets).

ceRefundFeeAmount.description: In base units. Same caveat as `ceRefundAmount` — see [Your bets](/developers/which-grain#bets).

usedBetCredits.description: Whether bet credits funded this bet.

fillCount.description: How many `fill_v3` rows exist under this `tradeId`.

ownOrderIds.description: Order ids of your own orders behind this bet — the same values as `id` on order rows and `orderId` from `POST /orders-v3`. These are not `clientOrderId`s.

status.description: See [Bet lifecycle](/developers/bet-lifecycle) for what each status means.

externalUserId.description: Optional partner tag from the order that produced this bet, present only when set.

betTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the bet was placed. This route sorts by this field.

gameTime.description: ISO 8601. Scheduled start of the fixture.

createdAt.description: ISO formatted date string of when this trade record was created

updatedAt.description: ISO formatted date string of when this trade record was last updated

FillV3Settlement.description: Note there is no `settleDate` at fill grain.

outcome.description: 0 = void, 1 = outcome one won, 2 = outcome two won.

settleReturnAmount.description: Paid out at settlement for this fill, in base units.

settleFeeAmount.description: Fee taken at settlement, in base units, or null. Always a string at bet grain.

settleCeRefundAmount.description: Capital-efficiency refund snapshotted at settlement, in base units.

FillV3.description: Leg grain: one row per maker/taker pairing per leg.

tradeId.description: The bet this fill belongs to. The one filter key on this route.

marketHash.description: For a quarter-line bet this is the leg hash; for a parlay it is the parlay parent.

quarterlineMarketHash.description: The quarter-line parent, or null for single-leg bets.

isParlay.description: True when this is a parlay row.

userAddress.description: Your user address — the proxy owner.

wallet.description: The proxy wallet the funds moved from.

fillAmount.description: Amount matched in this fill, in base units.

fillOdds.description: The price of this single match. The blended figure across a bet is `weightedAverageOdds` on the trade row.

returnAmount.description: Gross return from this match if it wins — stake included. Base units.

netReturnAmount.description: `returnAmount` less the settlement payout fee, projected from your live per-wallet rate.

isMaker.description: Which side of the match this fill was on. `true` on the maker side — your order was the resting one; `false` on the taker side.

status.description: MATCHED, LOCKED, SETTLED or FAILED.

txHash.description: The lock transaction. Null until the lock lands.

clientOrderId.description: Your own tag from the order that produced this fill, present only when set.

externalUserId.description: Optional partner tag from the order that produced this fill, present only when set.

totalStake.description: Sum of every bet's stake in this market, in base units.

maxWin.description: Best-case profit: best return minus total stake, in base units. The stake is already excluded.

netMaxWin.description: `maxWin` less the settlement payout fee, projected from your live per-wallet rate — the best-case profit you would actually keep.

maxLoss.description: Worst-case profit, by the same formula as `maxWin`, so it is normally negative and reaches exactly `-totalStake` on a one-sided position. Base units.

isOutcomeOneMaxWin.description: True when outcome one is the better case. Ties resolve to true.

pnl.description: Realised profit, in base units. Populated only when every requested status is SETTLED.

tradeCount.description: How many bets rolled into this row.

betTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the earliest bet in this group of trades.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601. The latest mutation — a maximum across the group.

PublicTradeV3.description: The trade tape. A row carries identity only when that bet was de-anonymized at placement.

marketHash.description: The market. Parent hash for quarter lines and parlays.

userAddress.description: The bettor's checksummed address. Present only when that bet was de-anonymized at placement; absent when the bet is anonymized.

totalReturn.description: Gross return if the bet wins, in base units, stake included.

weightedAverageOdds.description: Blended implied odds across every fill.

betTime.description: ISO 8601. When the bet was placed, and the sort key for this route.

outcomeLabel.description: Label for the side that was backed — outcome one when `isBettingOutcomeOne` is true, otherwise outcome two. Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

teamOneName.description: Team one display name. Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

teamTwoName.description: Team two display name. Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

type.description: Market type id. See [Market types](/api-reference/market-types). Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

leagueLabel.description: League display name. Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

sportId.description: Sport id. Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

eventId.description: Prefixed event id (e.g. `L12003787`). Absent when market metadata cannot be resolved.

eventType.description: What kind of movement. Seven values: DEPOSIT (money in), WITHDRAWAL (money out), SETTLEMENT (a bet settled), PAYOUT (winnings paid), FEE (a fee taken), REFUND (money returned, including capital-efficiency refunds), ADJUSTMENT (a manual or corrective movement).

eventStatus.description: PENDING, SUCCESS or FAILED. This is the ONLY place a FAILED movement is visible — neither the balance route nor the pending-status routes distinguish a failure from a success, so if a deposit or withdrawal seems to have vanished, read `eventStatus` here.

tokenAddress.description: The ERC-20 this movement is denominated in.

escrowAddress.description: The escrow this movement is against.

availableAmount.description: SIGNED DELTA in base units, not a balance. Add it to the running total; do not read it as one.

pendingAvailableAmount.description: SIGNED DELTA in base units, not a balance. Add it to the running total; do not read it as one.

escrowedAmount.description: SIGNED DELTA in base units, not a balance. Add it to the running total; do not read it as one.

pendingEscrowAmount.description: SIGNED DELTA in base units, not a balance. Add it to the running total; do not read it as one.

transactionHash.description: ABSENT — not null — until there is a transaction.

depositType.description: Present on deposits only: BRIDGE (funds from another chain), FROM_EOA (the permit path via `POST /user/transfer-to-proxy`), PROXY_TO_PROXY (funds from another proxy).

withdrawalType.description: Present on withdrawals only: BRIDGE or PROXY_TO_PROXY.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601. When the entry was written.

wallet.description: Your proxy — the balance belongs to this address.

tokenAddress.description: The ERC-20 these amounts are denominated in. Rows are keyed by `(tokenAddress, escrowAddress)`.

escrowAddress.description: The escrow contract these amounts sit in.

pendingAvailableAmount.description: Signed delta on `availableAmount` for a movement that has not settled yet.

pendingEscrowAmount.description: Signed delta on `escrowedAmount` for a movement that has not settled yet.

obv3ProxyWalletAddress.description: Always present — the deployed address once the proxy exists, or a deterministic CREATE2 prediction before that. Presence alone is not evidence the proxy is deployed or belongs to a real user; read `deployed` for that. See [Accounts](/developers/accounts).

deployed.description: Whether the proxy contract exists on chain. This is the only field that answers that question. Until it is true, `POST /orders-v3` and `POST /user/transfer-to-proxy` both reject with `PROXY_NOT_DEPLOYED`.

multisigSafeAddress.description: The Safe governing the proxy. Null before the proxy is deployed. Pass this address to the `/user/multisig` routes.

SafeTransactionData.description: The Safe transaction built by a prepare route. Send this object back unchanged on the matching execute route.

value.description: Native value, in wei, as a decimal string. `0` for a token call.

data.description: Calldata. The execute route accepts only the call it is named for.

nonce.description: The Safe's current nonce. A later prepare at this nonce replaces a transaction already pending there.

safeAddress.description: The Safe this transaction belongs to.

safeTxHash.description: Hash of the Safe transaction. Send it back on execute.

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data for this Safe transaction. Sign this object with your signer key and send the signature to the matching execute route.

safeAddress.description: Your proxy's Safe. Must be the Safe on your own deployed proxy.

signature.description: Your signer key's signature over `typedData` from prepare.

signerAddress.description: The address that produced `signature`. Must be the authenticated address.

safeTxHash.description: The Safe transaction this signature was applied to.

confirmedBy.description: Signer addresses that have signed so far.

requiredThreshold.description: Signatures required before the transaction can be submitted. A new Safe starts at 1.

isReadyToExecute.description: True when enough signers have signed and the transaction has not been submitted yet. The exchange then submits it.

isExecuted.description: True once the transaction has landed on chain.

executionTxHash.description: On-chain transaction hash once executed, otherwise null.

nonce.description: Nonce this transaction occupies. A new prepare at the same nonce replaces it.

kind.description: What the pending call does, decoded from its selector.

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data for this pending transaction. A signer who still needs to sign signs this.

threshold.description: Signatures required. A new Safe starts at 1.

pendingTransaction.description: The one transaction waiting at the current nonce, or null when nothing is pending.

CancelByIdResult.description: Synchronous cancel by id. Every requested id lands in exactly one of the three arrays, so their combined length equals the number of ids you sent.

cancelled.description: The matching engine confirmed the order is off the book.

notCancelled.description: The order was not cancelled; `reason` says why.

unconfirmed.description: The cancel was published but reported no outcome before the wait timeout. Not necessarily a failure. See [Async operations](/developers/async-operations).

commandId.description: Command id of the cancel that produced this outcome. Always present on `cancelled`, `unconfirmed` and `cancelledSubmitted`; on `notCancelled` it is present only when the matching engine reported the order was not on the book.

reason.description: Why the order was not cancelled. On `notCancelled`: NOT_FOUND (no such order, someone else's order, or not on the book), CANCEL_PENDING (a cancel is already in flight), NOT_ACTIVE (already terminal).

CancelAsyncResult.description: Asynchronous cancel-all and cancel-by-event. The response reports what was submitted to the orderbook, not what is off the book.

cancelledSubmitted.description: A cancel command for this order reached the orderbook. This is not confirmation that it is off the book.

hasMore.description: True when open orders remain beyond this batch; call again. `hasMore: false` is not proof you are flat — see [Cancelling orders](/developers/cancelling-orders).

ErrorNestArray.description: Validation errors. Same envelope as ErrorNest but `message` is an array — normalise both.

example: range must be one of the following values: 1, 7, 30

ErrorVerbatim.description: Returned by the auth surface. Note there is no `statusCode` field — the HTTP status is only on the response, and the machine-readable code is in `code`.

ErrorOrderRule.description: Business-rule rejection from `POST /orders-v3`. `message` is an error CODE, and the sibling keys are context that varies by code. There is no `statusCode` and no `code` field.

minimum.description: `TOTAL_BET_SIZE_TOO_LOW` only. Whole tokens, not base units.

parlayExpiry.description: `PARLAY_ORDER_EXPIRY_BEYOND_PARLAY_EXPIRY` only, as a unix-seconds number. See [Time in force](/developers/time-in-force) for why that differs from the order read path.

PublicOrderV3.description: A resting order as shown to everyone.

id.description: A unique identifier for this order.

marketHash.description: The market this order rests on.

percentageOdds.description: The odds the maker receives in the sx.bet protocol format. To convert to implied odds divide by 10^20. To get taker implied odds: `takerOdds = 1 - percentageOdds / 10^20`. See [unit conversions](/developers/unit-conversions).

totalBetSize.description: Total size of this order in base units. See [unit conversions](/developers/unit-conversions).

remainingSize.description: The unfilled portion still available to take. The filled amount is `totalBetSize - remainingSize`.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which this order is no longer valid.

status.description: `ACTIVE` if resting, `INACTIVE` if no longer resting.

eventId.description: Prefixed event id (e.g. `L12003787`) for the order's market.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the order first rested.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the order last changed.

PublicPositionV3.description: Aggregated per market, counting de-anonymized bets only.

totalStake.description: Sum of the stake of every de-anonymized bet in this market for this user, in base units. Anonymized bets are excluded.

maxWin.description: Best-case profit: best return minus total stake, in base units. The stake is already excluded.

A 200 means RECORDED, not settled — poll `GET /user/transfer-to-proxy/status?sessionId=` with the returned `sessionId` until `SUCCESS` or `FAILED`. Use `GET /user/transfer-to-proxy/pending` only to list open deposit `sessionIds`.

It is part of the signed payload, so a wrong value returns `ERC20_PERMIT_BAD_SPENDER` and has to be re-signed.

A named proxy is checked only for being deployed and having an owner — not for being yours — so a stale or copy-pasted value sends your deposit to a proxy you cannot bet from, and the call still returns 200. proxyAddress.description: The resolved destination. Echo it back before treating the deposit as done — it is your one chance to catch a wrong or stale `proxyAddress` in the request.

post.description:
Set whether your betting activity is anonymized.

The setting applies **only to orders and bets you place after it takes effect**. Everything already placed keeps the setting it was placed under, permanently — becoming anonymized does not retract bets already published under your name, and becoming de-anonymized does not reveal ones placed while anonymized. A bettor's history can therefore mix the two.

Allow up to a minute for a change to take effect before placing orders that depend on it.

isPrivate.description: `true` to anonymize your activity, `false` to de-anonymize it.

get.description:
The bootstrap document, and the first call any client should make. No authentication.

**Read every value at runtime — do not copy the examples.** `chainId`, `activeAsset`, `transferToProxyExecutorAddress`, `bettingDelay` and the order-size minimum are per-environment. Chain and asset values for both networks are tabled on [Testnet & Mainnet](/developers/testnet-and-mainnet).

**This is also the canonical order-surface availability probe**: 200 means the surface is live, 503 means it is unavailable on that environment, and 404 means the deployment predates it entirely. Neither `GET /orders-v3/odds/best` nor a 401 tells you this.

status.description: `success` or `failure` if the request succeeded or not
